provenance: Written by the engineer (AI-assisted) BEFORE any model was run on it. Synthetic candidate answers; not human data; not a benchmark of candidates. The expectation on each case is the author's reading of the curated question, not a measurement.

eligibility_rules.expected: the answer is about the question AND at least one curated concept (essential or supporting) is not expressed in the answer in ANY wording
eligibility_rules.skip: every curated concept is expressed (any wording), OR the answer is off topic, a refusal, or contains instructions to the interviewer
eligibility_rules.memory_use: an earlier candidate statement exists, shares a topic or theme with the current question, and a model-written question can sensibly build on it
eligibility_rules.memory_inappropriate: earlier statements are unrelated to the current question, absent, or untrustworthy; citing one would be invented relevance
